name: Fact Check Bot
tagline: Hand it a claim, stat or viral post and get a straight verdict on what holds up.
description: Whatever the unit of doubt, whether a headline, a statistic, a screenshot or a piece of folk wisdom, it goes and checks the thing against dependable sources. The answer comes back plainly: what is supported, what is exaggerated and what falls apart. Useful before you repeat something, forward it or build on it.
author: cu30rry_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
